title: Agentry managed settings document bound to its members (schema managed-settings/2)
description: The payload of a managed settings envelope that the registry binds to the accounts it is for. A registry that signs several documents for one organization at one version, one for each combination of teams with settings, binds each to its members, so that a member who holds another member's document cannot put it in place of their own. Everything managed-settings-1.schema.json says holds, and in addition a client applies the document only when members names the account it is signed in as. Closed schema: unknown keys are invalid.

registry.description: Base URL of the registry that signed the document.

org.description: Handle of the organization whose settings these are. A client accepts the document only while the signed-in account is an active member of it.

version.description: Increases with every change the organization's admins make. A client refuses a version lower than the last it accepted from the same organization.

issuedAt.description: When the registry signed this version.

members.description: The accounts the document is for. Each digest is the first 16 bytes of SHA-256 over the bytes "agentry managed-settings member", a zero byte, the salt and the account's id, so the document names its members only to a client that knows its own account.

salt.description: 16 random bytes drawn for this document, base64 (standard, padded).

digests.description: Sorted, distinct lowercase hex digests, one for each account.
